title: American Express 2022 Form 10-K — 比率定义章节（仅定义监管资本比率）
key_points: 该 10-K 正文中明确定义的比率是 Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital Ratio 与 Tier 1 Leverage Ratio。
Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital Ratio 定义为 Tier 1 capital 除以 risk-weighted assets。
Tier 1 Leverage Ratio 定义为 Tier 1 capital 除以最近一季度的平均合并总资产。
该来源未定义 quick ratio / acid-test ratio，说明 10-K 类文件不提供本子问题所需的比率定义。
raw_excerpt: Tier 1 Risk-Based Capital Ratio — Calculated as Tier 1 capital, divided by risk-weighted assets. ... Tier 1 Leverage Ratio — Calculated by dividing Tier 1 capital by our average total consolidated assets for the most recent quarter.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Item 7 MD&A, Financial Condition: Liquidity and Capital Resources
key_points: AMD states that as of December 31, 2022 its cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments were $5.9 billion, compared to $3.6 billion as of December 25, 2021 (consistent with the balance-sheet figures $4,835M + $1,020M = $5,855M).

The increase in cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments was primarily driven by $2.4 billion of cash and $1.6 billion of short-term investments acquired from the Xilinx acquisition, $1.0 billion from issuance of the 3.924% Notes and 4.393% Notes, and cash flows from operations, partially offset by stock repurchases and cash paid for the Pensando acquisition.

Aggregate principal debt obligations were $2.5 billion as of December 31, 2022, consisting primarily of $1.5 billion of Xilinx Notes assumed in the Xilinx acquisition and $1.0 billion of 3.924% Notes and 4.393% Notes issued during the year.
AMD repaid $312 million of its 7.50% Senior Notes that matured in August 2022, which is consistent with the current portion of long-term debt being nil at FY2022 year end.

A five-year unsecured revolving credit facility of $3.0 billion aggregate principal was entered into on April 29, 2022 with Wells Fargo Bank as administrative agent; no funds were drawn from this facility during the year ended December 31, 2022.
A commercial paper program of up to $3.0 billion was established on November 3, 2022; as of December 31, 2022 AMD had no commercial paper outstanding.
The percentage of cash and cash equivalents held domestically was 73% as of December 31, 2022, versus 91% as of December 25, 2021.
Net cash provided by operating activities was $3,565 million in 2022; investing activities provided $1,999 million; financing activities used $3,264 million.

title: Quick ratio derived arithmetically from AMD's filed FY2022 balance-sheet line items (computation, not a company-reported metric)
key_points: Using the standard quick ratio definition (cash & equivalents + short-term investments + receivables, excluding inventories and prepaid/other current assets) over total current liabilities, the FY2022 figures imply (4,835 + 1,020 + 4,126) / 6,369 = 9,981 / 6,369 ≈ 1.57x.
Including the $2 million receivables from related parties in the numerator gives 9,983 / 6,369 ≈ 1.57x, i.e. the result is unchanged at two decimal places.
Equivalently, (total current assets − inventories − prepaid expenses and other current assets) / total current liabilities = (15,019 − 3,771 − 1,265) / 6,369 = 9,983 / 6,369 ≈ 1.57x.
For reference, the current ratio on the same filed figures is 15,019 / 6,369 ≈ 2.36x.
The quick ratio is a derived figure computed from filed line items; the 10-K itself does not report a quick ratio or current ratio.
raw_excerpt: Derived from filed line items: (Cash and cash equivalents 4,835 + Short-term investments 1,020 + Accounts receivable, net 4,126) / Total current liabilities 6,369 = 9,981 / 6,369 ≈ 1.57x. Current ratio = 15,019 / 6,369 ≈ 2.36x. (Arithmetic performed on the Consolidated Balance Sheets figures at p56; not a metric disclosed in the filing.)

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Note 5 Business Combinations: Xilinx purchase price allocation
key_points: Xilinx acquisition closed February 14, 2022 (Xilinx Acquisition Date); total purchase consideration $48,793M.

Current assets acquired at fair value: cash and cash equivalents $2,366M; short-term investments $1,582M; accounts receivable $299M; inventories $539M; prepaid expenses and other current assets $61M (total current assets acquired ≈ $4,847M).
